data.name: BLACKHOLE
data.detailed_description:
Coming soon:


BLACKHOLE: Complete Edition OUT NOW!

One of the highest-scoring puzzle platformers of 2015 is coming back in a Complete Edition featuring the award-winning game BLACKHOLE, all available DLC (including the brand new Challenge Vault) and plenty of bonus materials!

BLACKHOLE: Complete Edition is packed with extra content, such as:

  • 3 pieces of DLC (Testing Lab, Secret of the Entity, Challenge Vault)

  • Over 130 levels, including 10 all-new, insanely difficult locations

  • Digital artbook and soundtrack featuring more than 40 tracks

  • Developer diaries

  • Playable first prototype of the game

  • Printable high resolution artwork

  • 12 wallpapers and collector cards


Acerca do jogo

BLACKHOLE is an award-winning hardcore platformer with over 15 hours of story-driven sci-fi comedy and gravity-twisting puzzles. Complete Edition now available!

When the crew of the spaceship Endera is sucked into a black hole, it seems like the end. Fortunately, the ship crashes on Entity – an unidentified object resembling a planet. After the crash, the first member to wake up is the guy who makes coffee for the crew - you! There’s no one around and your only ally is Auriel, the ship’s computer’s sarcastic A.I. Together, you’ll need to come up with a plan to fix the spaceship, save the others and become heroes of planet Earth by closing the black hole once and for all. It won’t be an easy task, because the mysterious caves, lost cities, towering mountains and deep forests are full of tricky, gravity-defying puzzles and deadly traps.

Main features:

  • More than 90 levels in 6 dimensions to explore

  • Hundreds of secrets to discover and puzzles to solve

  • A fully-voiced sci-fi comedy with a cool soundtrack

  • Pixel-perfect controls for both keyboard and gamepad

reviews.review:
[h3] 🎮 BLACKHOLE [/h3]

[code] [quote=Wendrex] # **BLACKHOLE**

**Developer:** FiolaSoft Studio  
**Publisher:** Fulqrum Publishing  
**Playtime:** 3.8 hours  
**Platform:** PC / Steam  
**Status:** 👍 **Recommended**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🎯 **A Platformer That Turns Every Mistake Into a Lesson**

**BLACKHOLE** is the kind of game that proves a massive production budget isn't necessary to create a demanding experience. Its strengths are found in level design, responsive controls, and the way movement, positioning, and timing are turned into compact gameplay puzzles.

After a few hours, the game's philosophy becomes clear: the objective isn't simply to reach the end of a level. It's to **understand how the environment works and master its rules**.

---

## 🎮 **Gameplay — 8.5/10**

BLACKHOLE combines 2D platforming with puzzle elements and challenges built around movement and positioning.

Its strongest feature is the way the environment becomes part of the gameplay itself. Platforms, hazards, positioning, and movement trajectories aren't merely decoration — they are part of the solution.

The controls feel responsive, which is essential for this genre. When you miss a jump, the game usually gives you the feeling that **your execution was the problem**, rather than the controls being unreliable.

That puts BLACKHOLE in the same conversation as games such as **Super Meat Boy** and **VVVVVV**, although BLACKHOLE places more emphasis on solving situations and understanding the space around you.

The result is gameplay that rewards observation before execution.

---

## 🔁 **Loop & Replayability — 8/10**

The core loop is straightforward:

**explore → understand the obstacle → experiment → fail → adjust → master.**

It's a familiar structure for puzzle-platformers, but BLACKHOLE keeps it engaging because new situations constantly force you to rethink how you approach the environment.

Replayability also comes from improving your performance, exploring stages, and pursuing additional objectives. Players who enjoy completion and mastering levels have reasons to keep playing beyond simply reaching the end.

This isn't a game relying on endless procedural content. Its longevity comes primarily from **challenge quality and the desire to master situations that initially seemed difficult**.

---

## 🎨 **Graphics & Immersion — 8/10**

BLACKHOLE uses a colorful and highly stylized visual identity.

It isn't trying to compete with AAA productions, and it doesn't need to. The art direction works because important gameplay elements remain visually readable.

That's especially important in a platformer. The player needs to quickly identify platforms, hazards, and interactive elements.

The presentation also gives BLACKHOLE its own personality instead of making it feel like another generic indie platformer.

---

## 🔊 **Sound — 8/10**

The audio design does its job well.

Sound effects provide useful feedback for actions and interactions, while the soundtrack supports the atmosphere without overwhelming the gameplay.

The music isn't the main reason to play BLACKHOLE, but it contributes effectively to the overall rhythm and atmosphere.

It's functional, cohesive, and well integrated into the experience.

---

## 📈 **Difficulty — 8.5/10**

This is one of the game's strongest aspects.

BLACKHOLE doesn't simply increase difficulty by throwing more obstacles at the player. The challenge grows primarily through **greater mechanical mastery and more demanding environmental reading**.

Some sections can be quite demanding, especially for players who aren't accustomed to precision-focused platformers.

But there's an important difference between unfair difficulty and demanding difficulty.

BLACKHOLE generally falls into the latter category.

You fail, understand why, and try again. When you finally execute the sequence correctly, the reward comes from the feeling of mastery rather than from an artificial progression system.

---

## ⚙️ **Performance — 9/10**

During my time with the game on PC, performance was solid.

The game is lightweight, controls respond quickly, and I didn't encounter performance issues that interfered with gameplay.

That's particularly important for a precision platformer: **input latency, stuttering, or inconsistent performance can completely ruin the feeling of control**.

BLACKHOLE simply lets you focus on the challenge instead of fighting the technology behind it.

---

## 🆚 **Comparison**

### **Super Meat Boy**
Shares the philosophy of trial, error, and execution mastery, while BLACKHOLE puts more emphasis on environmental problem-solving.

### **VVVVVV**
Both games make movement and physics fundamental parts of the challenge, although BLACKHOLE develops its own presentation and structure.

### **Portal**
The comparison is more conceptual than mechanical: both reward players who observe the environment and understand its rules before acting.

BLACKHOLE's main strength is the combination of **platforming, exploration, and problem-solving**, without relying exclusively on reflexes.

---

# ⭐ **SCORE**

🎮 **Gameplay:** 8.5/10  
🎨 **Graphics:** 8/10  
🔊 **Sound:** 8/10  
⚙️ **Optimization:** 9/10  
🔁 **Replayability:** 8/10  

## 🏆 **Final Score: 8.4/10**

---

## ✅ **PROS**

✔️ Responsive controls  
✔️ Strong platforming/puzzle combination  
✔️ Intelligent level design  
✔️ Challenge built around learning and execution  
✔️ Well-paced difficulty curve  
✔️ Consistent visual identity  
✔️ Solid PC performance  
✔️ Great for players who enjoy mastering difficult stages  

## ❌ **CONS**

❌ Can be demanding for players unfamiliar with the genre  
❌ Some situations require considerable trial and error  
❌ Not ideal for players looking for an extremely casual platformer  
❌ Replay value depends heavily on your interest in mastering and completing the content  

---

# 🏁 **CONCLUSION**

**BLACKHOLE is an easy recommendation for players who want a platformer that actually challenges them.**

With **3.8 hours played**, I've already seen enough to understand where the game's real strengths lie. They're not massive production values or an enormous campaign, but rather the quality of its challenges and level design.

This is a game that respects the player's intelligence.

It presents the problem, gives you the tools, and lets you discover the solution. When you finally overcome a difficult sequence, the satisfaction comes from knowing that **you understood the underlying logic and mastered it yourself**.

This isn't a platformer designed to be played on autopilot.

**If you enjoy precision, puzzles, trial and error, and the satisfaction of mastering mechanics after repeated failures, BLACKHOLE deserves your attention.**

👍 **Recommended.**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
**Tags:** #BLACKHOLE #Platformer #Puzzle #Indie #2D #Hardcore #Steam #FiolaSoftStudio

**Mini Review:**  
> A smart platformer that blends precision, exploration, and puzzle-solving without treating the player like a spectator. Challenging enough to demand attention, rewarding enough to make mastery feel earned. [/quote] [/code]
